status: 8 exploratory single-view art references; no 3D meshes generated or imported. Character identity, item names and designs are provisional; confirmed game mechanics are unchanged.
workflow_notes: Upload one standalone PNG per image-to-3D task. No manual screenshot or cutout is needed for these references.
Try the shore lantern first, then the sword; evaluate the actual 3D result in Godot before expanding the batch.
Inspect missing back-side geometry, material appearance and in-engine scale. Create collision shapes and optimize mesh complexity as needed.
The traveler is an appearance proposal only; animated use requires mesh, skeleton, skin weights and movement/attack animations. Do not treat this still image as an animation-ready character.
Fishing line and magical trails are intentionally omitted from the still references; implement them separately in the engine.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one standalone image-to-3D modeling reference for the indie game 未名之海.

Output exactly ONE object or ONE character, one coherent three-quarter view, centered and completely visible with comfortable margins, occupying about 80 percent of frame, on a clean solid light warm-gray background. Quality stylized 3D game asset render, not a flat sketch or photoreal product.
This is an exploratory art reference, not a finished game-ready mesh.
Subject: one youthful adult androgynous traveler, roughly six and a half heads tall, gentle quietly curious face, short dark brown hair, simplified anime features. Full body from head to boots, neutral relaxed A-pose, arms angled about 35 degrees away from body, both empty hands visible with relaxed separated fingers, legs slightly apart. Light ivory short jacket with muted sage small panels, simple dark charcoal cropped trousers, soft brown ankle boots, a short pale shoulder cloth lying close to upper back and not hiding hands, simple leather belt and a small close-fitting hip material pouch. Few broad seams, no dangling straps or tiny buckles. No weapons, no backpack blocking silhouette, no armor, no sailor outfit, no hat. Clothing designed for easy animation and readable limb separation. Keep hair masses simple. This is an optional protagonist appearance proposal, not locked gender or identity.
